title: return and throw take a postfix condition
purpose: return value if c, return if c in a void action and throw value if c run only when c holds; the value is evaluated after the condition and only then; return if a {...} else {...}; still returns an if expression.

provenance.expected_basis: grammar exit_value = "if" expr | expr postfix_if?; spec: the condition is evaluated first, the value only when it holds.
